description: TeamRankings team stat table for NBA or NFL, for one stat page (for example points-per-game): rank, team, the season value, last 3 games, last game, home and away averages, and the previous season, as TeamRankings publishes them. Takes about 13 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_espn_standings when you need ESPN standings for NBA, NFL, MLB or NHL, by conference; sports_fanduel when you need FanDuel Sportsbook game lines for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

stat.description: Stat slug as in teamrankings.com/<sport>/stat/<slug>, e.g. points-per-game (default)
